overrides.eslint-plugin-jsx-a11y: 6.10.2 (its latest) still caps its eslint peer at ^9. Its rules run fine on ESLint 10, so we broaden the peer to match. An explicit range is used rather than the `$eslint` self-reference, which crashes `npm install` on npm 10 (edgesOut null). Remove once jsx-a11y ships native ESLint 10 support.
overrides.minimatch / glob: Advisories GHSA minimatch (DoS via globparts amplification, fixed in 11.0.1) and glob (AbortSignal cancellation bypass, fixed above 14.0.1) are unpatched in the versions eslint, typescript-eslint and workbox-build still depend on. Both are build/lint-time only. The overrides are scoped by version range so the older minimatch 3.x/5.x copies, which the advisory does not cover, are left alone. Remove each once the parents ship the patched ranges themselves.
